test_title: PYST 02: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

"The manager will approve the application."

options.text: The application will be approved by the manager.
The application is approved by the manager.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "The manager will approve the application."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the application" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "will approve" to "will be approved" (future simple passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "the manager."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The application will be approved by the manager."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The application has been approved." – Incorrect tense (present perfect passive).
 
• **Option 3: **"The application was being approved." – Incorrect tense (past continuous passive).
 
• **Option 4: **"The application is approved by the manager." – Incorrect tense (present simple passive).
